packageRules.description: This role installs InfluxDB OSS v2 and is shaped around it throughout: the DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_* setup variables, the /var/lib/influxdb2 and /etc/influxdb2 paths, and the /api/v2 surface the Molecule scenario probes. InfluxDB 3 Core is a different product rather than an upgrade, and InfluxDB 3 Enterprise is proprietary; see the warning at the top of README.md. The 3.x line currently ships only under -core and -enterprise tags, which semver versioning reads as prereleases and skips, so today nothing keeps Renovate on the 2.x line except that coincidence of tag naming. This says it outright instead.
